title: Bubblegum Warrior Poses
description: Three side-by-side illustrations of a young female character with pink bubblegum hair and a crown, wearing dark green and black armor with a cape. She is shown in three distinct action poses: blowing a bubble with fist raised, arms crossed in a fighting stance, and walking forward with an alert expression.
prompt: A cartoon character sheet on a solid bright green background showing three full-body poses of a tough young girl with voluminous pink curly hair in pigtails, wearing a small golden crown, dark green and black fantasy armor with bubble-like details, green cape, and heavy boots. She is blowing a pink bubblegum bubble in the first pose, standing in a combat stance with arms crossed in the middle, and walking forward with a surprised expression in the third. Vibrant colors, clean line art, dynamic character design.
